              The purpose of this program is to clarify the goals of studying abroad and finding employment, and to achieve those goals, aim to improve human basics and improve basic academic ability through self-discovery and self-enlightenment.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This lesson is conducted for the Department of Architecture, Faculty of Architecture, and the following contents are standard.
Class schedules are subject to change. Please check the notices on the Student Portal and handouts carefully.

1. Guidance on entering a university or employment
2. Employment practice test
3. Lecture 1: A lecture by a corporate HR representative
4. Lecture 2: Lectures by seniors working in business
5. Lecture 3: Lectures by  undergraduate students and master course students
6. Career introduction and campus seminar
7. Creating a resume
8. Interview guidance

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック
